name: Mobile menu
description: The task involves creating a Vue.js component for a side overlap menu suitable for mobile view by adapting the "tools" section from an existing `NavigationBar.vue` file. The provided code snippet outlines the `MobileMenu.vue` component with a vertical layout, icons, labels, and interactive menu items. The menu is designed to be responsive, hidden by default, and can be toggled with additional JavaScript or Vue.js logic. Comments suggest adding a background layout with a dimmed cover that emits a "close" event when clicked, and also emitting the "close" event after any tool is clicked.

messages.content:
From the NavigationBar take the "tools" section and create a side overlap menu vuejs component showing the tools for mobile with the icon and name of the tool.

Copy the tools markup and adapt as a  portrait menu
